== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Combat Response (V) (Virtual Block 7)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Combat Response (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Combat Response (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] column.
